answer_2.quote: Two metrics are standard, "..." MRR/NDCG models ... The MRR metric measures the number of retrievals to retrieve the human-derived answer. ... the NDCG metric measures the rank of all the correct candidates based on dense annotation...

answer_4.quote: the dense-annotations cue is more applicable in ambiguous questions ... three annotators were asked to mark all the correct candidate answers.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators mark which candidate answers are correct for each question.
